title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：patriotism　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 patriotism 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the clerk ① showed the patriotism that no applicant in the office would have noted, and he said the showing was the whole of the month. The ② patriotism, meaning the love itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; patriotism, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sort of patriotism in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ patriotism at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Patriotism, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the clerk said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the patriotism was the whole of the matter, meaning the duty and not the love. The ⑥ patriotism, meaning the duty and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; patriotism, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both love and a duty. He said the duty is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ patriotism had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ patriotism of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of noting; patriotism, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ patriotism I remember is the patriotism noted in the file, which closed in 1971 and is still noted as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Patriotism, my mother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all patriotism, she said, is a duty that has agreed to look like love. She said the duty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 爱国心（指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 爱国心（指那份爱国心本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：show the patriotism 表这一份爱国心
D. n. 爱国心（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 爱国心之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的爱国心之事）
F. n. 爱国心（指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一份）
G. n. 爱国心、本分（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 本分（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: showed the patriotism that no applicant in the office would have noted
The patriotism, meaning the love itself and not the stamp
Every sort of patriotism in that office
the patriotism at the far counter
the patriotism was the whole of the matter
the patriotism had become a line in a file
The patriotism of the whole thing

answers.why: show the patriotism 意为“表这一份爱国心”，1964 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记下的一份爱国心做了一遍。
patriotism 意为“爱国心”，指那份爱国心本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
patriotism 意为“爱国心”，指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
patriotism 意为“爱国心”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
patriotism 意为“爱国心、本分”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份本分就是那件事的全部。
patriotism 意为“本分”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份爱国心，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
patriotism 意为“爱国心”，指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1969 年这一份成了卷宗里的一行。
patriotism 意为“爱国心之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的爱国心之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记下。
patriotism 意为“爱国心”，我记得的是卷宗里记下过的那一份，1971 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一份。
patriotism 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，爱国心是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的爱国心。
